items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: This is a formal delivery (Zustellungsurkunde); the envelope scan on page 2 states 'zugest. am 23.11.2026' (Monday), so that printed date is the delivery day and no days are added. § 67 OWiG grants two weeks from delivery to file Einspruch. Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB the delivery day itself is not counted; a two-week period that begins with an event ends on the day two weeks later that corresponds by name to the event day, i.e. Monday 23.11.2026 + 2 weeks = Monday 07.12.2026. 07.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Niedersachsen, so no further shift is needed.

items.title: Pay the fine (Geldbuße, fee and delivery costs) once the notice becomes final
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: The notice becomes rechtskräftig (final) the day after the Einspruch period lapses without an objection being filed, i.e. Tuesday 08.12.2026 (the day after the 07.12.2026 Einspruch deadline computed above). Per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB, that day is not counted and the two-week payment period ends two weeks later on the day corresponding by name to Tuesday, i.e. Tuesday 22.12.2026. 22.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Niedersachsen. This date is contingent on no Einspruch being filed before 07.12.2026; if an Einspruch is filed, the fine is not yet enforceable and this date no longer applies.

warnings: The sender's e-mail address 'bussgeld@stadt-musterwilhelmshaven-bu.example' uses the reserved '.example' domain, which is not a real domain a genuine city authority would use — verify this contact detail before using it.
